1.

Father, we have wandered astray In darkness far from Thee; But Thy grace has overflowed, Met us far from the homeward path. Tenderly Thou hast kissed us, O Father, Garment, ring, and shoes Thou hast given, Slain for us the fatted calf, And prepared a feast.

2.

Clothed in garments of honour, At Thy table we are permitted to sit, Rejoicing in Thy fatherly love, Seeing how Thou art glad also; Glad, for many, mourned as dead, Thou hast restored alive, Glad, for Thou hast found again Many who were lost.
